elements.description:
An AI answer marked up claim by claim: source type, confidence, uncertainty, the passages behind each claim and a
counter-position; claims can be sent to verification.

properties.name: claims
properties.description: The answer as claims, in order – each with its source type, confidence and sources; items without `source` are plain text

properties.name: sources
properties.description: The passages the claims rest on, looked up by id

properties.name: counter
properties.description: The strongest case against the answer – shown folded under it; empty hides it

properties.name: open
properties.description: Id of the claim whose detail is open (null: none)

properties.name: queued
properties.description: Ids of the claims already sent to verification – their button says so

properties.name: now
properties.description: The moment source freshness is counted to (epoch ms), passed to every validity badge; unset, each badge uses when it connected

properties.name: confidenceBands
properties.description: Confidence at or above `high` reads High, at or above `medium` Medium, else Low

properties.name: sourceLabels
properties.description: The names of the source types – your own vocabulary in place of Sourced, Model knowledge and Inferred

properties.name: sourceNotes
properties.description: What each source type means, in the open claim

properties.name: uncertaintyLabels
properties.description: The names of the uncertainty kinds – in place of Not settled, Thin evidence and Beyond the model

properties.name: uncertaintyNotes
properties.description: What each uncertainty kind means, in the open claim (a claim's own `note` follows it)

properties.name: confidenceLabels
properties.description: The words for the confidence levels – in place of High, Medium and Low

properties.name: verifyLabel
properties.description: The button that sends a claim to verification

properties.name: queuedLabel
properties.description: What that button says once the claim is queued

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: The open claim changes; detail `{ open: string | null }` (ClaimOpenChange). Cancelable.

events.name: tc-queued-change
events.description: "Send to verification" was pressed; detail `{ queued, claim }` (ClaimQueuedChange) – the ids in the queue after it. Cancelable.

events.name: tc-verify
events.description: A claim was sent to verification (after tc-queued-change, whether or not that was prevented); detail `{ claim, sources }` (ClaimVerifyDetail)

props.name: open
props.description: Id of the claim whose detail is open – controlled when defined (null: none)

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Id of the claim open at first (uncontrolled)

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the open claim changes (null: closed)

props.name: queued
props.description: Ids of the claims already sent to verification – controlled when defined

props.name: defaultQueued
props.description: Ids already sent when `queued` isn't controlled

props.name: onQueuedChange
props.description: Called with the queued ids after a claim is sent

props.name: onVerify
props.description: Called when a claim is sent to verification, with the sources it rests on – add it to your verification queue

changelog: **Trust & calibration**, from THEMIS and built domain-neutral: - claims and their reliability: `tc-claim-answer`, `tc-verification-queue`, `tc-reflection-gate`, `tc-reliance-gauge`, `tc-disagreement-banner`, `tc-synthesis-notes`; - where outputs came from: `tc-lineage-graph`, `tc-validity-badge`, `tc-provenance-summary`, `tc-correction-propagation`, `tc-attestation-check`, `tc-run-manifest`; - policy and control: `tc-policy-simulator`, `tc-gate-config`, `tc-coverage-matrix`, `tc-kill-switch`, `tc-playbook-canvas`.
